## Context
Story: 7cf8-84fc-c5ea-48ff — sprint shared scripts accept caller-specific prefixes and PR title/body

## Goal
Add DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX and DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE env var support to plugins/dso/scripts/create-sprint-draft-pr.sh. Remove RED marker from .test-index.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/create-sprint-draft-pr.sh | modify | tests/scripts/test-create-sprint-draft-pr.sh | needs-modification |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Open plugins/dso/scripts/create-sprint-draft-pr.sh
2. After PRIMARY_TICKET_ID validation (env var validated before defaults are set, so DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE can safely reference PRIMARY_TICKET_ID in its default), add:
   DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX="${DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX:-Sprint:}"
3. Add DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE default AFTER PRIMARY_TICKET_ID validation:
   DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE="${DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE:-Long-lived sprint draft PR. Epic: {{PRIMARY_TICKET_ID}}.}"
   (This default preserves the existing literal body for backward compatibility with the sprint caller)
4. Find the line that constructs pr_title (currently: pr_title="Sprint: ${EPIC_TITLE} (${PRIMARY_TICKET_ID})")
   Replace with: pr_title="${DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX} ${EPIC_TITLE} (${PRIMARY_TICKET_ID})"
5. Replace the pr_body line (currently: pr_body="Long-lived sprint draft PR. Epic: ${PRIMARY_TICKET_ID}.")
   With interpolated template using bash parameter expansion:
   pr_body="${DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE//\{\{PRIMARY_TICKET_ID\}\}/$PRIMARY_TICKET_ID}"
6. Update the Usage comment in the script header to document the new env vars and their defaults
7. Remove RED marker for create-sprint-draft-pr.sh from .test-index

## Acceptance Criteria
- create-sprint-draft-pr.sh has DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX env var with default 'Sprint:'
- create-sprint-draft-pr.sh has DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE env var with default 'Long-lived sprint draft PR. Epic: {{PRIMARY_TICKET_ID}}.' (preserves current literal for backward compatibility)
- DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE default defined AFTER PRIMARY_TICKET_ID validation
- PR title uses DRAFT_PR_TITLE_PREFIX instead of hardcoded 'Sprint:'
- PR body uses DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE with {{PRIMARY_TICKET_ID}} placeholder interpolated to actual value
- When DRAFT_PR_BODY_TEMPLATE contains no {{PRIMARY_TICKET_ID}} placeholder, body is used as-is (no crash)
- Default behavior unchanged: env vars unset → title starts with 'Sprint:', body is 'Long-lived sprint draft PR. Epic: <id>.'
- Script header Usage comment updated to document new env vars
- RED marker removed from .test-index for create-sprint-draft-pr.sh
- Running test suite: previously-RED tests now PASS (GREEN)
- bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0 (or only other RED tests fail)
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
- ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
